title: Cosine
subtitle: Trigonometric · Periodic
summary: Ratio of adjacent to hypotenuse. Even function.
detail:
\[ \cos x = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}} = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{(-1)^n x^{2n}}{(2n)!} \]

Even function: \(\cos(-x)=\cos x\). \(\cos x=\sin(x+\pi/2)\). Zeros at \(x=(2n+1)\pi/2\). The exponential form: \(\cos x = \operatorname{Re}(e^{ix})\).
